item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable evidence that Putin in 2023 pursued an explicit, broad-based prosperity strategy centered on diversification, broad civilian welfare gains, or institutional conditions for long-run growth. The available evidence is mostly the opposite: war spending, patronage, and regime-stability spending. The only clear positive indicator is headline GDP growth, which is too thin to outweigh the stronger extractive/loyalty-oriented pattern.","evidence":[{"title":"Rosstat’s first 2023 estimate put GDP growth at 3.6% year over year","publisher":"Rosstat","date":"7 Feb 2024","url":"https://www.rosstat.gov.ru/folder/313/document/230009","summary":"Weak pro-side evidence: Russia still recorded positive headline growth in 2023, which shows macroeconomic resilience. But this is only aggregate output, not proof of broad-based or sustainable prosperity.","question_ids":["5B.1"]},{"title":"Putin publicly said Wagner and Yevgeny Prigozhin had received almost $2 billion from Russia in the previous year","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"3 Jul 2023","url":"https://theprint.in/world/putins-comment-on-funding-wagner-shows-link-to-ukraine-prosecutor/1652212/","summary":"Strong evidence against broad-based prosperity: state money was being used to finance a proxy force and preserve coercive capacity, which is closer to rent allocation and political protection than productive development.","question_ids":["5B.1"]},{"title":"Russia’s 2024 defense spending will soar by nearly one-third, says finance minister","publisher":"Reuters via Gulf News","date":"21 Sep 2023","url":"https://gulfnews.com/world/europe/russias-2024-defense-spending-will-soar-by-nearly-one-third-says-finance-minister-1.1695304856805","summary":"Shows a large spending surge tied to the war in Ukraine. That points toward short-term war mobilization, not long-run civilian prosperity.","question_ids":["5B.1"]},{"title":"Russia’s 2024 defense spending rise record share of budget","publisher":"Reuters","date":"29 Sep 2023","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-2024-defense-spending-rise-record-share-budget-2023-09-29/","summary":"Defense spending was reported to be about a third of the federal budget. That is inconsistent with a priority on broad, sustainable welfare and productive investment.","question_ids":["5B.1"]},{"title":"Putin framed elevated military spending as necessary to meet army needs and sustain wartime capabilities","publisher":"Kremlin","date":"19 Dec 2023","url":"https://en.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/73072","summary":"Best official justification on the pro-side, but it is explicitly about sustaining war capacity. It does not show a strategy aimed at inclusive prosperity.","question_ids":["5B.1"]},{"title":"After the Wagner mutiny, Putin publicly rewarded soldiers and cast the military as the guarantor of state stability","publisher":"Kremlin","date":"27 Jun 2023","url":"https://en.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/71520","summary":"This is loyalty management: public rewards to security forces and military elites to stabilize the regime. It supports a read of buy-loyalty politics rather than broad-based prosperity.","question_ids":["5B.1"]},{"title":"The mutiny itself showed that armed force and security networks were central to regime survival, and that loyalty management was a major function of military power in 2023","publisher":"Reuters via Reuters Connect","date":"26 Jun 2023","url":"https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/moment-putin-says-wagner-mutiny-is-treason-in-televised-address/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMucom,2023:newsml_VA240124062023RP1","summary":"Reinforces that elite loyalty and coercive capacity were core governing aims in 2023. That is not the same as building durable prosperity for the broader population.","question_ids":["5B.1"]},{"title":"Putin’s approval remained high after the mutiny, with the July 2023 table showing 69% approve / 23% disapprove","publisher":"Levada Center","date":"14 Jul 2023","url":"https://www.levada.ru/en/2023/07/14/approval-of-institutions-ratings-of-politicians-and-parties-at-the-end-of-june-2023/","summary":"Weak counterevidence only: high approval can help a ruler sustain legitimacy, but it does not demonstrate that he was creating broad-based prosperity rather than preserving popularity.","question_ids":["5B.1"]}]}
